    How trade-in works
    How trade-in works
    1. Upgrade and save
    Accept your estimated trade-in value, buy your new device at the current price, and receive your delivery.
    2. Prepare device
    Sign out of all accounts linked to your old device, and factory reset it to erase your personal information.
    3. Ship within 30 days
    Print your shipping label, package your old device, and drop it off at any UPS location within 30 days of receiving your new device.
    4. Get your rebate
    After we receive your trade-in device, we'll verify it within 10 business days. Once verified, you'll receive your trade-in value as an Amazon.com Gift Card to your Amazon account for immediate use.

    About this item

    • SPLIT THE VIEW. MULTITASK¹ TO THE MAX: Productivity never felt this powerful. Use up to three apps¹ at once on the expansive inner screen of Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. You’ll enjoy plenty of space to work, play, connect and more.
    • MULTITASKING MADE SMARTER WITH AI: Stay one step ahead with AI² that suggests which apps you might need next. Then view those multiple windows side by side on the large screen of your Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra.
    • ANY SHOT, ALL THE DETAILS: Dive into the details of any image with our best camera on a foldable smartphone. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra boasts a 200MP camera — and an upgraded 50MP Ultra Wide lens — for both stunning wide shots and extreme close-ups.
    • ELITE CHIPSET. FLUID GRAPHICS: Experience what’s possible with our most advanced Galaxy Z Series processor. From immersive gaming and speedy multitasking to the latest Galaxy AI³ features, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 keeps everything running seamlessly.
    • THE BATTERY YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR: It’s the battery you’ve been wanting in a foldable cell phone. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra packs a powerful ultra-sized⁴ battery in an ultra-slim design. Plus, with Super Fast Charging 2.0⁵, charge up faster than ever before.
    • THE BRIGHTEST DISPLAY ON A GALAXY PHONE: Our brightest smartphone display⁶ provides you with a comfortable view, whether you’re inside or outside. Watch movies, play games and scroll with ease no matter where you are.
    • EASILY OPEN AND EXPAND YOUR POTENTIAL: Unfold a whole new dimension of productivity. Effortlessly open Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and watch as it transforms from a premium bar smart phone into an expansive, tablet-like experience to maximize your multitasking.
    • LOCK IN TO THE MOMENT: Bring on the bumps, jumps and chaos. Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock⁷ keeps your footage perfectly upright for smooth, level footage every time.
    • A DIGITAL WALLET IS ALREADY IN YOUR GALAXY: Streamline your life, starting with your wallet. Store payment cards⁸, boarding passes⁹, digital IDs¹⁰, and more. All easily accessible right on your phone with a swipe up.

    • What are the key features of Galaxy Z Fold8?

      Galaxy Z Fold8 offers a unique foldable design with long-lasting performance, advanced photography and AI features. Designed with an all-new shpae, the cover screen's 10:16 aspect ratio is perfect for scrolling.

    • What is the difference between Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra?

      As our product line evolves, our original Z Fold model has advanced to become Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and the Z Fold8 model has been resdesigned with an all-new shape.

    • I’m switching to Galaxy for the first time. How easy is it?

      The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to. And do it all on Galaxy Z Fold8.

    • How durable is Galaxy Z Fold8?

      Galaxy Z Fold8 is fortified with materials that strengthen the device for long-lasting durability. The Armor Aluminum frame provides enhanced protection for the device's internal components and exterior edges without adding excessive bulk.

    • Does Galaxy Fold8 support S Pen?

      No Galaxy Z Fold8 does not support S Pen.

    Product Description

    Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is the multitasker’s secret weapon. Flexing a massive 8" screen¹¹ while staying just 4.1mm thin, it’s a command center-size display that folds and fits in your pocket. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is a foldable that gives multitaskers like you everything they need to thrive.

    Side-by-Side Multi Window¹ turns that expansive screen into a productivity playground by allowing you to use up to three apps at once to enjoy plenty of space to work, play and more.

    With our latest custom processor, you have the speed you need for seamless multitasking along with a 5,000mAh battery —the same size as the one powering our Galaxy S26 Ultra. Plus, you can get back to getting more done quickly with Super Fast Charging 2.0.⁵

    While you’re out doing it all, take pics that capture it all. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra boasts a 200MP camera and now also includes a new 50MP Ultra Wide lens that delivers four times the detail of its predecessor, ensuring crisp shots from up close to far away.

    Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is a foldable that gives multitaskers like you everything they need to thrive.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    About this Item

    • SPLIT THE VIEW. MULTITASK¹ TO THE MAX: Productivity never felt this powerful. Use up to three apps¹ at once on the expansive inner screen of Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. You’ll enjoy plenty of space to work, play, connect and more.
    • MULTITASKING MADE SMARTER WITH AI: Stay one step ahead with AI² that suggests which apps you might need next. Then view those multiple windows side by side on the large screen of your Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra.
    • ANY SHOT, ALL THE DETAILS: Dive into the details of any image with our best camera on a foldable smartphone. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra boasts a 200MP camera — and an upgraded 50MP Ultra Wide lens — for both stunning wide shots and extreme close-ups.
    • ELITE CHIPSET. FLUID GRAPHICS: Experience what’s possible with our most advanced Galaxy Z Series processor. From immersive gaming and speedy multitasking to the latest Galaxy AI³ features, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 keeps everything running seamlessly.
    • THE BATTERY YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR: It’s the battery you’ve been wanting in a foldable cell phone. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra packs a powerful ultra-sized⁴ battery in an ultra-slim design. Plus, with Super Fast Charging 2.0⁵, charge up faster than ever before.
    • THE BRIGHTEST DISPLAY ON A GALAXY PHONE: Our brightest smartphone display⁶ provides you with a comfortable view, whether you’re inside or outside. Watch movies, play games and scroll with ease no matter where you are.
    • EASILY OPEN AND EXPAND YOUR POTENTIAL: Unfold a whole new dimension of productivity. Effortlessly open Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and watch as it transforms from a premium bar smart phone into an expansive, tablet-like experience to maximize your multitasking.
    • LOCK IN TO THE MOMENT: Bring on the bumps, jumps and chaos. Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock⁷ keeps your footage perfectly upright for smooth, level footage every time.
    • A DIGITAL WALLET IS ALREADY IN YOUR GALAXY: Streamline your life, starting with your wallet. Store payment cards⁸, boarding passes⁹, digital IDs¹⁰, and more. All easily accessible right on your phone with a swipe up.
    • SWITCHING FROM IPHONE IS NOW EASIER THAN EVER: The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts, alarms and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to.¹⁵ And do it all on Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra.

    Product Description

    Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is the multitasker’s secret weapon. Flexing a massive 8" screen¹¹ while staying just 4.1mm thin, it’s a command center-size display that folds and fits in your pocket. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is a foldable that gives multitaskers like you everything they need to thrive.

    Side-by-Side Multi Window¹ turns that expansive screen into a productivity playground by allowing you to use up to three apps at once to enjoy plenty of space to work, play and more.

    With our latest custom processor, you have the speed you need for seamless multitasking along with a 5,000mAh battery —the same size as the one powering our Galaxy S26 Ultra. Plus, you can get back to getting more done quickly with Super Fast Charging 2.0.⁵

    While you’re out doing it all, take pics that capture it all. Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra boasts a 200MP camera and now also includes a new 50MP Ultra Wide lens that delivers four times the detail of its predecessor, ensuring crisp shots from up close to far away.

    Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is a foldable that gives multitaskers like you everything they need to thrive.
